name: Dub-space triangle comp
desc: Smoky late-set flavor: detuned triangle ireal voicings floating on long dub delays, off-beat struct, mask breathing every eight bars.

code.full: chord("<Dm9 G13 Cmaj7 Am9>").dict('ireal').voicing().struct("[~ ~ x ~] [~ x ~ ~]").s("triangle").add(note("0,.07")).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.75, ${cut}*1.2).slow(20)).attack(.3).release(1.3).gain(${gain}).room(.65).roomsize(6).delay(${dly}).delaytime(.5).delayfeedback(.42).mask("<1 1 1 1 1 1 1 0>").every(8, x=>x.fast(2)).orbit(4).play()
code.peak: chord("<Dm9 G13 Em7 A7 Dm9 G13 Fmaj7 E7>").dict('ireal').voicing().struct("[~ x] [x ~] [~ x] [x [~ x]]").s("triangle").add(note("0,.07,-.05")).lpf(sine.range(${cut}, ${cut}*1.5).slow(12)).attack(.15).release(.9).gain(${gain}).room(.6).roomsize(6).delay(${dly}).delaytime(.375).delayfeedback(.45).every(4, x=>x.fast(2)).orbit(4).play()
